images.title: A rectangular patchwork
images.purpose: Show a patchwork of 5 rows of 8 patches with its length 8 cm and breadth 5 cm, so that the count by rows, 5 times 8, is seen to be length times breadth.
images.composition: The rectangle of patches on the left with its two sides marked, three lines of working on the right.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. At the top, centred at x 728 and y 62, the heading A rectangular patchwork in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (44 px). Centre left, a rectangle of exactly 8 columns by 5 rows of identical square patches, 40 patches in all, every patch 70 by 70 px filled teal #0072B2 with a thin dark #2B2B2B outline (3 px), spanning x 150 to 710 and y 170 to 520. Above the rectangle, centred at x 430 and y 118, the label 8 cm with a thin dark arrow line 560 px long under it spanning x 150 to 710 at y 150, with an arrowhead at each end; left of the rectangle, centred at x 80 and y 345, the label 5 cm with a thin dark arrow line 350 px long spanning y 170 to 520 at x 130, with an arrowhead at each end. To the right, at x 800, three lines of text, 5 rows of 8 patches at y 280, 5 × 8 = 40 at y 350 and Area 40 square cm at y 420 (40 px, dark #1F2937). In all 1 rectangle, 40 patches, 2 labelled arrows. No other number and no other text anywhere. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
a rectangle with a number of columns other than 8 or of rows other than 5
any value other than 8 cm, 5 cm, 40 and the listed lines
images.takeaway: Count by rows: the patches in a row is the length, the number of rows is the breadth, and the area is length times breadth.
images.description: A patchwork of 5 rows of 8 patches, 8 cm long and 5 cm broad, with 5 × 8 = 40 and an area of 40 square cm.
images.context: Concept image for Area of a Rectangle: Length × Breadth. It follows the idea of the patchwork in your maths book (rows of patches, length and breadth) and uses the numbers of this concept's own example.
images.teaching_notes: Let the student count one row and then the rows, and see that no patch needs counting one by one. The slip to watch: adding the length and breadth.

image_decisions.why: The rows of patches make area as rows times patches in a row visible.
